plan.summary: SE (Sales Engineering) 170 senaryo JSON dosyasından template_catalog tablosuna scenario/FAQ/intent template seed eden servis ve endpoint. Onboarding wizard için sektör bazlı template altyapısı.
plan.q_intent: SE klasöründeki 170 senaryoyu template catalog'a import et — onboarding wizard'da kullanılacak
plan.interview_notes: Hedef: non-technical kullanıcılar (dişçi, e-ticaret yöneticisi vb). Self-service onboarding. Sektör seçince şablonlar otomatik yüklensin. SE senaryolarından al.

files_changed.change: SE scenario JSON parser + template extractor (scenario/FAQ/intent) + batch insert via TemplateRepository
DI registration + POST /api/v1/templates/seed-from-se endpoint (superadmin, dry_run support)

verification_questions.question: Does SeSeedService correctly map all 10 SE niche values to DB sector values, with crossSector/universal becoming scope=platform?
Are FAQ templates only extracted from valid user→bot consecutive step pairs (user>=5 chars, bot>=30 chars, no system messages)?
Is the endpoint properly guarded with GetSuperadmin (tenant_id=0) check, preventing tenant-level access?
Does the intent deduplication correctly merge keywords and sample_messages for same intent_name within the same sector?
Is BatchInsertTemplatesAsync called with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING ensuring idempotent re-runs?

intentional_exclusions: type=flow template extraction — complex graph generation deferred to separate paket

try_catch_locations: SeSeedService.cs: JsonException catch per file parse
SeSeedService.cs: IOException catch per file read
SeSeedService.cs: NpgsqlException catch per batch insert
user_facing_errors: INV-KN-029: Database error during SE seed
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All helper methods are instance methods with logger access. Every catch block logs with SystemWarn. No static methods with catch blocks.
